summary: Frontend-only regression after Vercel build-fix (date-fns pinned to 3.6.0, .npmrc legacy-peer-deps, resolutions/overrides). Verified via preview URL: home '/' renders brand header 'Elios Tech — Magazzino', 'Checklist Spedizione', all four input fields (Nome Operatore/Data Spedizione/Cliente/Numero DDT), filter chips Tutti(42)/Accessori(23)/E-Bike(1)/Go-e(2)/Stand(4)/Wallbox(12) with correct counts, inventory rows loaded from Notion (Cavo Molex, Cable Dock Daze, Modem Daze, etc.). /admin login with admin123 works; all three tabs (Inventario Notion / Destinatari / Storico) switch and load data (9 spedizioni in Storico). Zero console errors, zero pageerrors, zero date-fns / react-day-picker module-resolution errors on both routes. Bundle loads cleanly.

issues: Date-da/Date-a use browser-native date input (mm/dd/yyyy) rather than shadcn Calendar — inconsistent with data-spedizione HTML5 date on home; low priority, unchanged by this build fix

critical_code_review_comments: package.json now has three redundant date-fns pins (dependencies=3.6.0, resolutions=3.6.0, overrides=3.6.0). Keep them aligned to avoid future drift.
.npmrc legacy-peer-deps=true only affects npm/Vercel; note in README so future upgrades to react-day-picker v9 remove the workaround.
seed_data_creation: none — instructed not to create shipments (would decrement Notion stock)

QR scanner button was not visible from home page top-level — if next test needs to verify QR scanner, look for it inside per-row inventory expand or a fab; was not reachable via generic 'QR/Scan' text search on '/'.
